triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Here he is, that man, my dear little brother, whom I love more than any one in the world, the only one I love in the world.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: Nothing, brother—it’s the fright you gave me. Oh, Dmitri! Father’s blood just now.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Here he is, that man, my dear little brother, whom I love more than any one in the world, the only one I love in the world.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Brother, you don’t seem to have noticed how you’ve insulted Katerina Ivanovna by telling Grushenka about that day.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: And she flung it in her face just now that she had gone to gentlemen in secret to sell her beauty!

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: and Katerina Ivanovna’s cry: “Your brother is a scoundrel!”

triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: Understand, Alexey, that if you return to the world, it must be to do the duty laid upon you by your elder, and not for frivolous vanity and worldly pleasures.

triples.subject: Lise
triples.quote: Dear Alyosha, I love you, I’ve loved you from my childhood, since our Moscow days, when you were very different from what you are now, and I shall love you all my life.

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: As he was praying, he suddenly felt in his pocket the little pink note the servant had handed him as he left Katerina Ivanovna’s.
